conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Investigations Department. This is Officer Martin speaking. With whom am I speaking today?
Hello, my name is Rajiv Patel. I got a message that I need to call the IRS immediately. What is this about?

Thank you, Mr. Patel. Before I continue, I have to inform you that this call is being federally recorded. We have identified significant discrepancies in your federal tax filings for the last three years.
I am sorry, I do not understand. I always file my taxes through a service. What kind of discrepancies?
Our audit reveals that you have underreported your income, which constitutes tax evasion under Section 7201. Can you confirm your current address on file so I can verify your identity?
Yes, I live at 1258 Lincoln Avenue, Apartment 3B, Springfield.

Thank you for confirming. Mr. Patel, as per our records, there is an outstanding tax debt of $6,432.85, and we have already issued a warrant for your arrest due to willful misrepresentation on your returns.
Warrant? Arrest? I do not understand. I am not trying to break the law. I am here on a work visa.
This is a very serious matter. If you fail to resolve this debt today, your work visa and driving license will be suspended, and local authorities will detain you. All your assets may also be frozen.
Please, I cannot lose my job or be arrested. How can I fix this? I do not want any trouble.
You have a legal right to settle this balance before the case moves forward. But time is short. We only have a window of one hour to process a payment and stop the legal proceedings.
How do I pay the IRS? Should I go to the website or something?

Due to the nature of your case, standard payment portals are not applicable. You need to follow the expedited government settlement process, which requires payment through a designated government crypto-wallet.
Crypto-wallet? I am not familiar with that. I have never paid taxes in this way before.
This is a secure and traceable method authorized for urgent settlements. I will provide you with the official wallet address. Do you have a smartphone or access to a Bitcoin ATM nearby?
I have a smartphone, but I have not used Bitcoin before. Is this necessary?

It is mandatory for urgent cases flagged as fraud. If you do not comply, I cannot stop the arrest warrant. Please download the Coinbase or Binance app immediately so I can guide you through the process.
Okay, I will try to download Coinbase. What do I do next?
Once you install the app, you will need to set up an account. When you are ready, let me know, and I will provide the IRS wallet address for payment.
I am opening the app now. This is very stressful. Can you please confirm again, is this really the IRS?
Mr. Patel, I am a federal investigator, and you are facing criminal charges. Non-compliance will result in immediate arrest. Are you ready to proceed with the payment?
Yes, I am trying. What is the address I need to send to?
Send the full outstanding amount of $6,432.85 to the following Bitcoin address: 1IRS-Settlement-23GHkL9wz5. Enter this address carefully, incorrect payments cannot be refunded.
I do not have that much money in my account. What happens if I cannot pay the full amount?
In that case, you must pay a minimum of $3,000 now to pause the proceedings. The remaining amount can be settled with a payment plan, but only if you act right away.
I will try to send $3,000. Should I take a picture or receipt after sending?
Yes, take a screenshot of the transaction confirmation and send it via this recorded line for auditing purposes. Do not disconnect the call while making the payment.
I am sending it now. It says 'pending.' Will this stop the arrest?
Once the payment is confirmed, I will file an immediate stay on your warrant and you will receive a clearance certificate. If you delay, authorities will proceed with your detention.
Okay, it is sent. Please help me clear this.
